name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Growth Marketer & AI-Driven Creative Systems Builder
summary: Growth marketer and AI systems builder with 15+ years across SaaS, MarTech, and agency environments. Writes and tests direct-response copy, landing pages, and short-form hook-driven video content, self-produced for Solenzo's own brand, while building AI-driven workflows that turn raw business and product information into structured, testable outputs, from personalized outreach sequences to a scored digital-footprint audit tool that enrolled 180+ businesses.

experience.title: Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Self-produce short-form, hook-driven, talking-head video content for Solenzo's own brand marketing, appearing on camera to build organic reach.
Built an automated prospect 'audit' workflow that enrolled 180+ contacts, scoring a business's digital footprint to trigger personalized outreach and content.
Translate non-technical stakeholders' generalized ideas and feedback into precise, structured AI prompts and agent instructions, bridging business intent and reliable LLM output.
Draft clean, specific, ethically aligned direct-response copy, outreach sequences, and landing pages that drive engagement and pipeline.
Configure and evaluate AI-generated response output for client automation systems, and built rubric-based grading criteria for the SEO audit process, scoring outputs against defined standards.
Build performance dashboards tracking lead generation, funnel progression, campaign ROI, and pipeline velocity, delivering insights that inform the next round of messaging and creative.

experience.title: Account Executive / Client Strategist
bullets: Produced high-converting campaign assets, landing pages, complex email sequences, and conversion-focused copy, improving lead generation and pipeline.
Designed and ran LinkedIn ad campaigns using an account-based-marketing approach, targeting small, highly researched audiences with A/B-tested setups rather than broad targeting.
Built rigorous campaign performance reporting frameworks tracking ROI, CAC, LTV, and conversion KPIs, delivering optimization recommendations and QBRs.
Managed integrated digital marketing strategies across inbound, paid media, and content, coordinating execution across internal departments.

experience.title: Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding
bullets: Collaborated with Product and Engineering to share structured, high-priority customer feedback informing the roadmap.
Analyzed partner utilization and performance metrics to identify adoption gaps and recommend interventions that reduced churn.

experience.title: Account Executive / Sales Operations
bullets: Analyzed campaign performance data and translated results into optimization recommendations across paid media and creative.
Ran client accounts end to end at a performance marketing agency, covering campaign execution, performance reporting, and cross-team communication.

experience.title: Account Manager, Onboarding Launch Specialist & Team Lead
bullets: Managed a high-value account portfolio across diverse verticals, contributing to a 30% increase in website traffic and 25% improvement in conversion rates across the e-commerce segment.
Led digital growth consultations aligning site architecture, inbound marketing, and SEO best practices to improve client traffic and conversion.

experience.title: Account Executive
bullets: Sold and scoped complex CRM and project-management software to agencies and professional-services firms, with deep fluency in sales enablement, contact management, and pipeline automation.
Built sequenced implementation plans for incoming clients, ranking which systems to change and in what order.

education: B.A. Liberal Arts, Minor in Political Science — Colorado State University, Fort Collins, CO (2009)
certifications: Google Digital Marketing & E-Commerce Professional Certificate — Google / Coursera (2024)
